metadata.description: Personal cross-environment plugins for safety guardrails, @steelmasterj/js-components development, and accessibility-first frontend PR reviews.

plugins.name: safe-guardrails
plugins.description: Always-on PreToolUse safety hook blocking sensitive file reads (.env, keys, credentials), destructive commands, irreversible actions, and git force pushes.

plugins.name: js-components
plugins.description: Skills and subagents for building and maintaining lightweight, vanilla, semantic, dumb presentational Vue 3 components in @steelmasterj/js-components.

plugins.name: web-review
plugins.description: PR review and accessibility audit skills plus a read-only frontend reviewer subagent prioritizing WCAG 2.1 AA, 320px responsiveness, and semantic HTML.

plugins.name: js-site-builder
plugins.description: Skill and architect subagent for building complete, modern, WCAG 2.1 AA accessible, responsive (320px+) websites from scratch with @steelmasterj/js-components, Vue 3 Composition API, Vite, vue-router, and semantic vanilla HTML/CSS.
